items.spec_gap_found: Mech B _used_archetypes was per-agent (tid → set). Spec requires 'NEVER USED in prior 7 days by anyone'. Fixed: new global _society_archetypes_by_day tracks society-wide used archetypes with trailing 7-day window cutoff. Per-agent tracking kept for reference.
new_globals: _society_archetypes_by_day: Dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)  # day_date → archetypes used society-wide
items.logic_change: assign_sacrificial_archetypes now computes cutoff = day_date - 7 days, collects society_used = union of _society_archetypes_by_day[d] for d >= cutoff, filters AXELROD_ARCHETYPES against society_used. Falls back to full pool if all 20 exhausted. Records assignments into _society_archetypes_by_day[day_date] after each call.

on_brain_wake: For each item where status=pending and owner contains 'local-agent-' — ASSUME the local CLI crashed if the local commit hasn't appeared in git log within 6h of updated_at.
Pick lowest-priority pending item; do the scope; commit (do_not_push=true means don't push).
Update this file: set status=done + commit_hash + completed_at OR status=blocked + reason.
on_cli_resume: Re-dispatches status=pending items whose local-agent hasn't committed in 30 min.
